notes.title: LOONEWS 7 | Erogoddess: Mirage Released & 69 Summon Succubus Update
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/41310298/d41f9d1a2127f3e3b333eae8217c72c640f19c1a.png[/img]

Dear friends [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2875500/Erogoddess_Mirage][b]Erogoddess: Mirage[/b][/url] is now available! Dating simulator with feminized Egyptian gods. Ra, Anubis, Seth, Osiris, Horus and other gods are waiting for you. Discover new gods by spinning the wheel of fortune. In the near future we will give away 10 keys to the game in our [url=https://discord.gg/s72EyyDaN6][b]Discord[/b][/url]!

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/41310298/be825650ddb0b013874751f2ca38727bd9afe884.gif[/img]

Also for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1727100/69_Summon_Succubus][b]69 Summon Succubus[/b][/url] an update has been released! The cute wolf Lucia has been added to the game.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/41310298/655ea170a027e0d7adc70659f89072959de6e43b.png[/img]

tags.feature: The cute wolf Lucia has been added to the game.

notes.title: Simplifying the gameplay and fixing bugs!
notes.content:
[h3][b]Dear players![/b][/h3]

At your request, the gameplay has been simplified and a critical error at the end of level 12 has been fixed. Thank you very much for your feedback!

tags.bug: a critical error at the end of level 12 has been fixed
